description: This file defines a report for item variant details in an ERP system, including functions to fetch and process item variant data, stock levels, prices, and attributes.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and compiles data for item variants, including stock, prices, and attributes.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the item variant report based on item attributes.

methods.name: get_open_sales_orders_count
methods.description: Counts open sales orders for given item variants.

methods.name: get_stock_details_map
methods.description: Retrieves stock details for item variants from the database.

methods.name: get_buying_price_map
methods.description: Retrieves average buying prices for item variants.

methods.name: get_selling_price_map
methods.description: Retrieves average selling prices for item variants.

methods.name: get_attribute_values_map
methods.description: Retrieves attribute values for item variants.
